SLA: A minute is in SLA when the median first token (TTFT p50) arrives within 1 s, the slowest 1 in 100 (TTFT p99) within 15 s, median generation speed (decode) is at least 60 tokens/s, and errors are at most 0.1%. A load passes only when all 15 measured minutes are in SLA.
